title: introduce-token-stepper-metrics-and-alert-deconflict
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: we see recurring noisy alerts driven by high-cardinality token-level signals and duplicate symptom alerts at both the invocation and per-token levels. This PR adds a compact per-token phase aggregator ("token-stepper") plus an alert deconfliction layer that correlates per-token anomalies with invocation-level health to reduce duplicate noisy alerts and improve SRE signal-to-noise. Design summary: token-stepper collects phase durations for each token (parse/encode/kv-lookup/generation/postprocess) but emits a laddered histogram with 8 fixed buckets per phase to keep cardinality bounded; each metric includes a three-bit sampler tag so we can reconstruct representative traces for tail cases without full trace capture; the alert deconflict engine receives candidate alerts from token and invocation pipelines, computes a lightweight correlation score (time overlap, tenant, route, and prompt-shape hash) and suppresses or groups noisy duplicates according to configurable thresholds and backoff windows. Implementation highlights: new collector: observability/metrics/token_stepper_collector.go implements collection + bucketing + sampler tag; tracing bridge: observability/tracing/stepper-trace-bridge.go maps sampler tags to trace sampling decisions; alerting engine: pkg/alerting/alert_deconflict.py implements correlation algorithm and backoff policy and exposes a metrics endpoint for deconflict decisions; dashboard: observability/dashboards/token-stepper-overview.json (Grafana) for laddered latency stacks, deconflict rate and suppression breakdown; docs and runbook: docs/runbooks/token-stepper.md documents rollout steps, expected metric shapes and how to debug suppressed alerts. Rollout plan: feature-flagged behind token_stepper_v1; staged rollout to 10% of traffic for 48h (observability tests + manual SRE review), then 50% for 24h, then global; backward-compatible: if feature flag disabled, collectors emit no new metrics; metric name namespace is opt-in. Migration notes: new metrics use a short 3-character suffix to avoid collision with existing metric families and require a lightweight TSDB schema bump to add laddered histograms; there is a one-time migration job described in the runbook. Testing: unit tests for bucketing and deconflict logic added (tests/unit/test_stepper_bucket.py, tests/unit/test_deconflict.py); integration tests simulate tail sampling and verify trace backfills (tests/integration/test_token_stepper.py). Performance: collector optimized to perform per-token accounting inline with amortized allocations; benchmark in perf/bench_token_stepper.md shows <1% p99 latency impact at 90% traffic sampling. Safety: added rate limits to deconflict decisions to avoid thundering herd suppression; added a fallback path to always surface invocation-level alerts for critical error classes. Why different from previous work: focuses on bounded-cardinality per-token shapes plus a heuristic deconflict engine to reduce alert duplication rather than more expensive span-join strategies. Links: Linear ENG-4215 covers design; SUP-3321 is the support ticket describing noisy alerts observed in production. Checklist: [x] tests added [x] docs/runbook added [x] dashboard added [x] feature-flag gated [x] perf bench completed; See changed_files for exact diffs and runbook for operational guidance.

review_conversation: Ravi Kapoor: Can we guarantee the metric cardinality bound across diverse prompt shapes?; Asha Patel: We limit per-route and per-phase labels and use 8 fixed buckets + a 3-bit sampler tag. We canonicalize prompt-shape via a stable shingled hash to avoid explosion.; Marta Svensson: Alert deconflict looks promising but please add a conservative default so we don't drop critical alerts; Asha Patel: added backoff windows and a whitelist of critical error classes; updated runbook to surface suppressed alerts and how to opt-out per-tenant.; Liam O'Connor: unit tests look good; could you add a small benchmark to demonstrate overhead?; Asha Patel: added perf/bench_token_stepper.md and included microbenchmarks showing <1% p99 impact at configured sampling rates.; Marta Svensson: approved; Ravi Kapoor: approved after small naming nit; Maintainer (merge): squash-merged after green CI and manual SRE signoff.
release_notes: Adds a bounded-cardinality per-token phase metric (token-stepper) and an alert deconfliction engine to reduce duplicate invocation/token alerts. Feature-flagged rollout. Improves SRE signal-to-noise and adds a Grafana overview and runbook.
notes_for_ops: Feature flag token_stepper_v1 must be toggled per-cluster; run the provided TSDB migration job before enabling on >50% traffic; follow docs/runbooks/token-stepper.md for rollback; monitor metric token.stepper.deconflict.suppressed_rate and token.stepper.ladder.* buckets during rollout.
how_to_verify: Enable feature flag on staging, run tests/integration/test_token_stepper.py, drive synthetic tail traces using perf/bench_token_stepper.md harness, verify deconflict metrics drop duplicate alert rate by >30% in dashboard, ensure critical invocation alerts still surface.
